Basic ATC

Pengaturan altimeter

The value to which the scale of a pressure altimeter is set so as to indicate elevation or height. In ATC phraseology, this typically refers to the current QNH for a given location.

Quick answer: The value to which the scale of a pressure altimeter is set so as to indicate elevation or height. In ATC phraseology, this typically refers to the current QNH for a given location.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Pengaturan altimeter?

In this glossary, Pengaturan altimeter refers to: The value to which the scale of a pressure altimeter is set so as to indicate elevation or height. In ATC phraseology, this typically refers to the current QNH for a given location.

How is Pengaturan altimeter used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Pendekatan: Delta 432, pengaturan altimeter 1013, turun dan pertahankan 3000 kaki."

Why does Pengaturan altimeter matter in aviation?

Pengaturan altimeter matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Pengaturan altimeter?

Pengaturan altimeter is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

Definition

The value to which the scale of a pressure altimeter is set so as to indicate elevation or height. In ATC phraseology, this typically refers to the current QNH for a given location.

Operational example

Approach: Delta 432, altimeter setting 1013, descend and maintain 3000 feet.

Localized term

Pengaturan altimeter

Localized example

Pendekatan: Delta 432, pengaturan altimeter 1013, turun dan pertahankan 3000 kaki.
